source: User explicit correction 2026-10-17: experiments target time-varying trajectories; fixed-reference equilibrium regulation is out of scope.
decision: The closed-loop theory must address time-varying trajectory tracking directly. Do not restrict the first theorem to constant-reference equilibrium regulation. Use time-indexed value functions, shifted reference sequences and time-indexed terminal targets/conditions.
rule: Retain the existing time-varying tracking objective as the research object.
Do not replace the task with fixed setpoint regulation for proof convenience.
A0/A1 analysis must account for reference shift, input-reference shift, input-increment cost and terminal continuation under time-varying references.
No paper/control edits yet; this is theory feasibility only.
boundary: This does not yet prove time-varying closed-loop stability.
Physical-plant stability still requires a model-to-plant bridge and detection/trajectory assumptions.
